observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 208.» (L5) and «p. 209.» (L33, beside the head of chapter 57) in the left margin. In «p. 208.» the 2 is printed broken, like £, and the 8 blotted; in «p. 209.» the 9 is blotted. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the head of chapter 57: 35 stands in the space between «CAPUT LVII.» and the title, 40 beside L37.
body: the running head of the page is printed «A. NALLINO», without the initial C.
body L33-L35: the head of the chapter is set in a larger type; «CAPUT LVII.» and the two lines of the title are centred.
body L34: a speck stands before «Libri» at the head of the title; it is not a sign.
body L37: the o of «libro» is printed broken, open at the top.
notes_right L3: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXII) read «138-139, adn. 5: Additamenta quorumdam codicum Platonis legantur in praefatione p. LII-LV.».
notes_right L2: the 3 of «22-23» is printed faint and broken.
body L5, L11: a speck stands before «nem» at the head of L5; a speck stands under the a of «supra»; they are not signs.
body L17: a speck stands over the e of «eumque»; it is not an accent.
notes_right L1: the 1 of «adn. 1.» is printed with a flag and a dot, like i.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
